subject: MAP and sequencing: evaluation milestones → MSA / DPA / Order Form gating (NorthStar Biologics)
messages:
From: Lena Morris <lena.morris@northstarbio.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@northstarbio.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff + initial evaluation schedule

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — good conversation. We're ready to formalize a mutual action plan so procurement and legal can map gating to specific evaluation milestones. I've attached a starter MAP (NorthStar_MAP_v1.xlsx) that ties our procurement artifacts to evaluation checkpoints.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm which evaluation deliverables will satisfy the "security evidence" gate (SOC 2 report, audit-log export, penetration test summary).
- Propose an MSA signature window that allows us to issue a PO; target date from our side is 2028-08-15.
- Call out any non-starters (data residency / deletion SLA / subprocessor list) we should flag now so legal can review early.

When you have an internal owner map for each lane (security, commercial, data protection, procurement), can you drop names into the MAP? That will speed approvals on our side. Once we have a sequencing suggestion, I'll route to our procurement and legal teams (Tom is copied).

Attached: NorthStar_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Lena Morris
Head of Procurement
NorthStar Biologics
[Attachment: NorthStar_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Morris <lena.morris@northstarbio.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jun 2028 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + initial evaluation schedule

Lena — thanks for the MAP and the clear asks. I've reviewed the worksheet and proposed a sequencing that balances our QA/eval cadence with legal gating. Summary below; I've uploaded an annotated MAP and a short runbook to the shared folder (link in related links).

Proposed sequencing (high level):
1) Evaluation kickoff (week 0) — Redwood provides demo artifacts and test plan. Owner: Grace (Redwood). Target: 2028-06-24.
2) Security evidence bundle (week 2) — SOC 2 Type II summary + audit-log export sample + penetration test summary. Owner: Karthik (Legal/Compliance). Target: 2028-07-08.
3) Acceptance / canary tests (week 4) — joint test with your engineering team covering latency and KV cache behavior on representative datasets. Owner: Hannah (Customer Success / Solutions). Target: 2028-07-22.
4) Commercial / order execution (week 6) — finalize MSA/DPA redlines, confirm PO terms, DocuSign signature. Owner: Grace (Commercial). Target: 2028-08-09 — allows your 8/15 PO target.

Key notes and constraints:
- Karthik flagged two clauses that typically extend review time: data residency carve-outs and deletion SLA language. If either is non-negotiable on your side, please flag immediately.
- For the SOC 2 artifact we can provide a scoped report and an evidence extract; let's confirm which evidence items your security team needs (we captured suggestions in the MAP comments).

Next steps (from Redwood side):
- I will drop names into the MAP lanes this afternoon and attach the runbook.
- Karthik will provide an initial redline of the MSA/DPA by Monday (we'll upload redlines_MSA_v2.docx).
- Hannah will schedule the canary acceptance window and share test criteria.

If that sequencing works for you, Lena, we'll treat the MSA/DPA review as the primary gating path to hit your 8/15 PO window.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
[Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNSB-MAP]
[Attachment: annotated_NorthStar_MAP_v1.xlsx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Lena Morris <lena.morris@northstarbio.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jun 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + initial evaluation schedule — legal redline summary

On Fri, Jun 17, 2028 at 11:34 AM Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Lena — thanks for the MAP and the clear asks. I've reviewed the worksheet and proposed a sequencing...

Lena / Grace — I took an initial pass at the MSA and captured the principal items that often lengthen cycles. I uploaded redlines_MSA_v2.docx to the shared folder and added inline comments to the MAP where the clauses intersect with acceptance gates. Short summary: 

- Data residency: NorthStar's requirement to restrict processing to eu-west-1 will require our private deployment option or a dedicated tenancy agreement. If this is a hard constraint, we should surface it before the acceptance/canary stage to avoid rework.
- Deletion SLA: proposed 30 days for soft-delete and 90 days for permanent purge — we can accept but need explicit language about logs and backups.
- Audit logs / evidence export: we can provide export samples but full raw log access is scoped; we'll provide an archive and a redacted sample for validation.

Action items for Redwood: 
- I've prepared the redline doc and highlighted the clauses that, if modified, will move the MSA milestone earlier.
- Need NorthStar to confirm whether eu-only processing is a must. If yes, procurement / infra will need to confirm capacity and pricing implications.

Hannah — can you confirm availability for a joint canary window 07/22‑07/23? I'll prioritize the redline updates so commercial can move quickly after your acceptance results.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redlines_MSA_v2.docx]

From: Lena Morris <lena.morris@northstarbio.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@northstarbio.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + initial evaluation schedule

Grace / team — thank you, this sequencing looks reasonable and clears up a lot. A few quick confirmations from NorthStar: 

- Data residency: we do not require eu-only processing — we can accept multi-region provided the DPA includes contractually-enforceable controls and a clear subprocessors list. That should allow you to keep the hosted route and avoid dedicated tenancy pricing.
- PO timing: the 2028-08-09 commercial milestone works for us and supports an 8/15 PO issuance if MSA/DPA redlines are reconciled by then.
- Canary acceptance: we'll schedule our infra + app teams for the 07/22 window; please share the test checklist.

Attached is our PO template (NorthStar_PO_template.pdf). Also please send the DocuSign envelope when the MSA is ready — our procurement team uses the DocuSign link in related_links.

Next steps we need from Redwood:
1) Finalize the annotated MAP with lane owners (Grace) — today.
2) Upload Karthik's redlines to the shared folder and confirm expected turn-around (Karthik) — by Mon 06/20 EOD.
3) Hannah to share canary test checklist before 07/15 so we can prep environment/credentials.

Once those are done we'll lock the target dates and route to our legal/procurement queue. Looking forward to moving quickly.

Best,
Lena Morris
Head of Procurement
NorthStar Biologics
[Attachment: NorthStar_PO_template.pdf]
